source: If we want to know a person, we need to have regular contact with them. It’s the same in our relationship with God: To get to know Him better, we need to make the time to spend with Him.
target: Bwetuba nga twagala okumanya omuntu, twetaga okubera n'enkwatagana nabbo. Ky'ekimu nemunkolagana yaffe ne Katonda: Okumumanya obulungi, twetaga okufuna obudde bwetumara naye.

source: The purpose of our time with God
To worship God: God is worthy of our praise and deserves our time.
target: Okusinza Mukama: Katonda agwanira okutendereza kwaffe era agwanira n'obudde bwaffe.

source: To talk with God: In prayer, we share with Him what is on our hearts. We listen to Him so that He can speak to us and lead us.
target: Okw'ogera ne Katonda: Mukusaba, tugabana ne Katonda ebiri ku mitima gyaffe. Tumuwuliliza naye asobole okwogera naffe era n'otukulembera.

source: To learn from God: God wants to teach us through His Word, the Bible, and His Spirit. This is like spiritual food for us so that we can grow.
target: Okuyiga okuva gy'ali: Katonda ayagala okutuyigiliza okuyita mu kigambo kye, mu Baibuli, n'omwoyo gwe. Kinno kilinganga emere ey'omwoyo gyetuli okusobola okukula.

source: Look up the following Bible verses and fill out the table: Which person is it talking about? When, where and how exactly does this person spend time with God?
target: Nonya enyiriri zinno ez'omubayibuli era ojjuzemu: Muntuki gw'eyogerako? Dii, Ludawa era omuntu onno amal'atya obudde bwe ne Katonda?

source: Tools and suggestions for our time with God
target: Ebikozesebwa n'ebitesedwa ku lw'obudde bwaffe ne Katonda

source: Bible: Read a passage from the Bible and then think and pray about it. You can use the head-heart-hands questions for this:
target: Bayibuli: Somayo enyiriri okuva mu Bayibuli era olowoze oluvanyuma ozisabilemu. Osobola okukozesa ebibuzo bya head-heart-hands kukino:

source: Place: Choose a place where you can meet with God without being distracted.
target: Ekiffo: Londa ekiffo w'oyinza okusisinkana ne Katonda nga tewali kiyinza kukubuzabuza.

source: Time: Find the best time when you can consistently meet with God.
target: Obudde: Zuula obudde obulunji bw'oyinza okusisinkanilamu Katonda nga tebutataganyizibwa.

source: Plan: Choose a Bible book to read through. For the beginning, read Luke and Acts (in the New Testament).
target: Entekateka: Londa ekitaabo mu Bayibuli eky'okusomamu. Kulw'entandikwa, soma Lukka n'Ebikolwa by'abatume (mundagano empya).

source: Making notes and sharing: Write down or share with your friends your thoughts, what you feel God is saying to you, your questions, the prayer requests of you or your friends, how God answered prayer, encouraging verses, …
target: Kora notisi era obeeko g'ozigabanako naye: Ziwandike oba gabana endowoza yo ne mukwano go, kiiki ky'owulira nti Mukama ky'akugamba, ebibuzo byo, ensonga zo ez'okusabira oba ezamukwano go, engeri Mukama gyeyayanukuramu esara yamwe, enyiriri z'omubayibuli ezizamu amanyi,...

source: My commitment for my time with God
